modules.title: Overview
modules.html:
Overview

Welcome to the documentation. This guide will help you understand the system architecture and get started quickly.

Key Concepts

Before diving in, familiarize yourself with these core concepts that form the foundation of our platform.

Architecture

The system is built on a modular architecture that allows for flexibility and scalability. Each component is designed to work independently while integrating seamlessly.

modules.title: Installation
modules.html:
Installation

Get up and running in minutes with our simple installation process.

Prerequisites

Ensure you have Node.js 18+ and npm installed on your system.

Quick Start

npm install
npm run dev

Configuration

Copy the example config and customize as needed for your environment.

modules.title: Authentication
modules.html:
Authentication Module

Secure user authentication is at the heart of the platform. Learn how to implement and customize the auth flow.

Login Flow

The login process follows OAuth 2.0 standards for maximum security and compatibility.

Session Management

Sessions are managed securely with HTTP-only cookies and short-lived tokens.

Multi-Factor Auth

Optional MFA support adds an extra layer of security for sensitive operations.

modules.title: API Reference
modules.html:
API Reference

Complete documentation for all REST and GraphQL endpoints.

REST API

All REST endpoints follow RESTful conventions. Base URL: https://api.example.com/v1

Authentication

Include your API key in the Authorization header.

Rate Limits

Standard tier: 1000 requests/hour. Contact support for higher limits.

modules.title: AI Voice Infrastructure
modules.html:
AI Voice Infrastructure

Advanced voice AI capabilities powered by state-of-the-art models.

Architecture

Our voice pipeline processes audio in real-time with sub-100ms latency.

Supported Languages

50+ languages with native accent support. Automatic language detection available.

Best Practices

Use streaming for real-time applications. Batch processing for analytics.

modules.title: LLM Integration
modules.html:
LLM Integration

Integrate with large language models for natural language understanding and generation.

Available Models

GPT-4, Claude, and open-source alternatives. Switch models with a single config change.

Prompt Engineering

Structured prompts with templating. Support for few-shot examples and chain-of-thought.
